## 23 · AI sandboxes and secure enclaves · [evidence](../slides/23-cyberinfrastructure/)

```text
Cyberinfrastructure
AI sandboxes and secure enclaves
The Data Store
Petabytes of iRODS collections on CyVerse. Public collections read anonymously, with no credentials at all.
Kubernetes AI sandboxes
Agents get the tools they are allowed and nothing else. Egress through a proxy, every call recorded.
Private inference
ACCESS-CI JS2, NRP, NIS: Self-hosted inference, model training, science gateways.
CARC: Locally hosted, private, open weight models
Co-scientists
Agents which write hypotheses, hypothesis tests (code), download and analyze data, report results, continuously.
MESA · NSF Award #2632685
```
notes: [~1.5 min · by 25:00] The practical slide: all four are bookable now. CyVerse allocations, Jetstream2 through ACCESS-CI. The sandbox is the other half of defense in depth: an agent only gets the tools it is allowed. CAISP is proof the pattern works at competition scale.
